{{Quote|After all these years, my most ''trusted'' of assassins has finally failed.|Ziro Desilijic Tiure|audio=KRONOS327Failed-TCWf.flac|<ref name="TCW film" />}}
'''KRONOS-327''' was a renegade [[Holowan Mechanicals/Legends|Holowan Mechanicals]] [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|IG-86 sentinel droid]] belonging to [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], a [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] of the underworld crime syndicate [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]]. Ziro allowed KRONOS to go without a [[Memory wipe/Legends|memory wipe]] for long periods of [[Time/Legends|time]], which granted the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] his own personality and the ability to gain experience from his missions. When one [[Mission to Yout 12|assignment]]&mdash;the [[Death/Legends|elimination]] of one of Ziro's rival Vigos on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yout 12]]&mdash;ended in failure in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], KRONOS returned to [[Ziro's Palace/Legends|Ziro's Palace]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. After the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] gave his report, Ziro expressed his disappointment and ordered that the droid be scrapped. KRONOS was subsequently taken away by a pair of fellow IG-86 droids.

==Biography==
{{Quote|O Ziro the Hutt, Master of the Hutt Clan on seven systems, I am sorry, Your Highness. It will not happen again.''"<br />"''I know. Take him away, and use him for spare parts!''"<br />"''No! No! Noooo!|KRONOS-327 and Ziro, after the droid's failure on Yout 12|audio=KRONOS327SpareParts-TCWf.flac|<ref name="TCW film" />}}
[[File:KRONOS-327.png|thumb|left|250px|KRONOS-327 reports his failure to Ziro the Hutt.]]
KRONOS-327 was an [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|IG-86 sentinel droid]] produced by [[Holowan Mechanicals/Legends|Holowan Mechanicals]].<ref name="TCWCG" /> Obtained by [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]], a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] of the criminal organization [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], KRONOS was utilized as an [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]]<ref name="TCW:TVG" /> and a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|79|IG-86}}</ref> Having rarely received a [[Memory wipe/Legends|memory wipe]], KRONOS was able to gain experience and develop a unique personality.<ref name="TCWCG" /> By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> KRONOS had been in Ziro's service for years and had earned the Hutt's trust,<ref name="TCW film" /> having [[Death/Legends|killed]] many of the Vigo's enemies.<ref name="CE" />

In 22 BBY,<ref name="ERC" /> as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] raged throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], Ziro [[Mission to Yout 12|sent]] the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yout 12]], to kill a rival Black Sun Vigo. KRONOS failed to complete his mission, but he did return to Ziro at [[Ziro's Palace/Legends|his master's palace]]<ref name="TCW film" /> in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TCW novel">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]]</ref> In the throne room of the palace, KRONOS delivered his report to the Hutt [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] and asked for a second chance,<ref name="TCW film" /> believing that he could easily complete the assignment if given another opportunity.<ref name="CE" /> Ziro expressed his displeasure in his most trusted [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]],<ref name="TCW film" /> and seeing KRONOS as useless, the Hutt activated a secret control that neutralized his weapons<ref name="TCW:TVG" /> and ordered that the droid be used for spare parts. KRONOS, screaming in fear of being dismantled, was then dragged from the chamber by two other IG-86 sentinel droids.<ref name="TCW film" />

==Characteristics==
KRONOS-327 was a Holowan Mechanicals-manufactured IG-86 sentinel droid, part of the [[IG-series/Legends|IG-series]] of combat droids.<ref name="TCWCG" /> The droid was utilized by Ziro the Hutt as an assassin<ref name="TCW:TVG" /> and a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter.<ref name="CSWE" /> As with other IG-86s in Ziro's service, KRONOS went large amounts of time without a memory wipe. As a result, the droid was able to gain substantial experience from his missions and even develop his own personality.<ref name="TCWCG" /> When KRONOS confronted Ziro following his failure on Yout 12, he asked for forgiveness from his master. As he was being dragged away by two other IG-86s, KRONOS verbally expressed his fear of being dismantled.<ref name="TCW film" />

KRONOS boasted a multi-[[Starship sensor array|sensor suite]] in his head, along with combat programming that aided in his targeting of opponents. He was knowledgeable in military tactics and possessed many features that aided him in his missions&mdash;among them, magnetic graspers that clasped onto weapons, and servos that enabled him to move in high gravity. The droid commonly used an underworld [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]].<ref name="CE" />

==Behind the scenes==
KRONOS-327 was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'', published in [[2008]].<ref name="TCW:TVG" /> In the same year, KRONOS appeared in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]], in which he was voiced by [[Corey Burton]]&mdash;the same actor who voiced Ziro. KRONOS's numerical designation "327" is yet another occurrence of the number in [[canon]].<ref name="TCW film" />
